scope: Structure, labelling (the control's aria-labelledby resolves to the field label and unit), rewiring and recipe classes of the web components in happy-dom (node:test), and the React renderers' server markup. Subgrid alignment is checked on the recipe rule and by eye in the jig; screen-reader output is not certified.

checks.covers: no native elements, parts beside the authored control, label and unit name the control (host-role controls; ui-input and ui-select through labelledby), description wiring, rewiring a swapped control, label press, slot readout, grid and layout classes
data-ui hosts, native label htmlFor, ids handed to the control (aria-labelledby = label + unit), readout and description parts, recipe classes

limitations: The source list is the direct sources, not every transitive dependency.
Subgrid alignment is asserted on the recipe rule; the rendered columns are checked by eye in the jig panel.
